notes.title: Capture the Flag: Jurassic Party Update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Vs52I8HPirI;full][/previewyoutube]
Dear Players, the new update is here! Join the new Capture the Flag game mode! Play on the new Museum Map. Finish the new Jurassic Party Operation, get the new T-Rex Operator, and many more! Let's gooooooooooo!

[h2]New Game Mode: Capture the Flag![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/5994d7dacfd704e54afde869e2ae8ddee02a863b.jpg[/img]
Get ready to dominate with the all-new Capture the Flag mode! It's the ultimate test of strategy, speed, and skill. Race across the map, and secure victory by grabbing the enemy's flag while protecting your own. Whether you're leading the charge or holding the line, teamwork is key. Are you up for the challenge? Flag captured, game on!

[h2]New Map: Explore the Museum![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/4f7b2285e9c81fef18c530474833c3051f56bd25.jpg[/img]
Step back in time -- and into the action -- in our newest map, Museum. This intense battlefield is set inside a sprawling natural history museum, where history meets mayhem. The centerpiece? A massive T-Rex skeleton towering in the grand gallery, offering both cover and a strategic vantage point.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/48d227e7096b39d5a2bfbadbdd79bd2ae728bbb7.jpg[/img]
On one side, a mammoth skull with colossal tusks looms in a cavernous room, perfect for close-quarters combat. On the other, an enormous T-Rex skull grins menacingly, adding a prehistoric thrill to every firefight. Get ready to hunt or be hunted in this epic clash of the ages!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/5c7f5e74d3687fc36178715636533027aef62106.jpg[/img]
Use the 24/7 Museum Capture the Flag game filter, to enter the epic non-stop fight through the ages!

[h2]Join the new Jurrasic Party Operation![/h2]
[i]The party was the time of my life.
200 million years of time, to be exact.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/e0950909cde4add1ad91a244c2262650d3f2b2f1.jpg[/img]
The city is having a grand opening thing for its new natural history museum. Your friend Gina works for the city, and she wants someone young to talk to. She didn't mention that it was also a costume party...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/a73bf9730bc754cbd54f61ee4a3cb1d2222faf94.jpg[/img]
But what is the humming coming from the basement? And what did the mayor mean when he said he was doing some research of his own? Your choices alone will determine whether or not this gala is one for the history books.

[h2]Get the New T-Rex Operator Bundle![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/3a5ea0dcfe67c5abd9e72c367200627036a17a53.jpg[/img]
These candy-colored, cardbacked catastrophes will cause opposing forces to quickly go extinct. This bundle also features the cuddly, carnivorous Rawr operator!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/7511cf98f314ffe3db8c8746e6e77dfd31f5aeab.jpg[/img]
Don’t let the toy-inspired designs fool you. These weapons are as lethal as you imagined they might be back when you were six years old.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/9cbfb88d823170d0a08c7e51f6164c3a97f5b647.gif[/img]

[h2]Join the Custom Loadouts Weapon Mode![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/99f594d9fea818dcdac1d009383e80110c0b711c.jpg[/img]
Get ready to amp up your game with Custom Loadout Lobbies! Imagine playing exactly the way you want: Snipers only, Pistols only, or even a wild Knives-only battle. The combinations are endless! What’s next -- gravity mods!? Who knows! Get out there, have a blast (with Thermite-only?), and good luck!

[h2]New version highlights:[/h2]
Dear Players! The new update is here!

- New Game Mode: Capture The Flag
- New Map: Museum
- New Operator: T-Rex
- Operation Jurassic Party
- Dino-themed bundle
- New Custom Lodout Game Mode: Play Snipers only, Pistols only, or even a wild Knives-only battle!

And many more fixes and optimizations!

We're gaining momentum with regular updates -- more to come next weeks!

Thank you for your love and greatest support,
Lets go!
Alfa Bravo Team
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/71ed21a8dbdd18e6c28722b916d591ee1a5ab6b6.png[/img]
